Subject: Inquiry: Redwood Inference + OpenLib integration

Hi Dylan / Marissa,

I signed up for Redwood via the GitHub link and wanted to request a short demo focused on integration with OpenLib (an open-source document search project). We're evaluating hosted inference for embeddings and hybrid setups where some models are self-hosted. A 30-minute call to cover:
- connector/auth patterns for GitHub-hosted repos
- embedding pipeline and storage options
- latency and cost tradeoffs for small-medium scale (10-50k docs)

I can do most afternoons PST this week. I attached a small snapshot of the repo and a quick README to give context.

Repo: https://github.com/openlib/openlib-core (public)

Thanks,
Alex Garcia
OpenLib / maintainer
